steps.name: Precondition — create a dedicated disposable agent
Step 1 — Navigate to agent detail page
Step 2 — Click the model selector dropdown
Step 3 — Verify all three Anthropic models are present in the dropdown
Step 4-6 — Select 'Anthropic Claude 4.5 Sonnet', save, and verify the chat response contains "CONFIRMED"
Step 7 — Select 'Anthropic Claude 4.6 Sonnet', save, and verify the chat response contains "CONFIRMED"
Step 8 — Select 'Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5', save, and verify the chat response contains "CONFIRMED"
Verify no console errors or warnings across the full flow
